name: Fairchild 670 stereo limiter
description: Fairchild Recording Equipment Corp. Model 670 stereo limiter, factory schematic A-96039 (670 DUAL LIMITER, manual Dec. 1959): per channel a 600-ohm T step attenuator (AT101/AT102) -> S301 L-R / lateral-vertical matrix -> T101 (R101/R102 180 ohm 1 %) -> push-pull variable-mu bridge of eight 6386 remote-cutoff sections (four in parallel per side; R103/R104 680 ohm, R105A/B ganged 100-ohm BALANCE with opposed wipers to chassis and to the L302 bias rail, C101/C102 4 uF across the cathode groups) -> T102 (R107/R108 30 ohm 1 % meter shunts, R111 33 ohm feed, VU meter through R106 4700 and S101) -> S301 output matrix; feedback side chain from T102's secondaries (R145-R150) -> T103 -> R115 AC THRESHOLD (centre-tapped, R113/R114 24K) -> 12AX7 class-B pair biased by R117 DC THRESHOLD / R116 / R118 / R119 -> 12BH7A pair -> 6973 push-pull with tertiary feedback (R128/R129, R134/R135) -> T104 -> 1N538 bridge -> R137 / C109 and the six-position S102 time-constant network, referred to the R142 ZERO bias, -> T101's centre tap. Supplies: GZ34 / L301 / C305-C306 450 V; EL34 + 6084 + 5651 series regulator at 240 V (R313); T301 bridge -> L302 / C303 cathode bias rail, R301 / R302 / R303 -17 V and -13...-14.5 V rails. Both channels in one instance (inputR / outputR).

sources.title: Fairchild Recording Equipment Corp., Model 670 Stereo Limiter Instruction Manual (Dec. 1959): specifications p.4-5, input/output connections, balance/zero and threshold adjustments, 'Input vs. Output Curves' (Dec. 1959), and schematic A-96039 '670 Dual Limiter' (p.14, 7110x6035)

Fairchild Model 670 schematic, redrawn (John Leimseider archive JL10880, 6576x5557; same drawing as JL10881 / thehistoryofrecording.com): cross-check for connections (hop-over crossings); values follow A-96039 where they differ
Fairchild Technical Bulletin, Model 660/670 Limiting Amplifiers (Leimseider archive JL10869): specifications, 'full limiting in the first 5,000th of a second'
General Electric 6386 Twin Triode, ET-T1113 (1953-54): transfer and plate characteristics, interelectrode capacitances (the two-triode card: work/tube-curves/6386)
Philips 6084 (E80F) long-life a.f. pentode data (8.8.1951, RTMA release #1029): typical characteristics and transfer curves (the regulator's error amplifier card)

P. Raffensperger, 'Toward a wave digital filter model of the Fairchild 670 limiter', DAFx-12: transformer ratio estimates (T101 1:9, T102 9:1, T103 1:17, T104 4:1 / 9.5:1), Lm 35.7 H, operating point (-7.2 V grid bias, -3.1 V balance), time-constant table; compared against

6386_A.note: 6386 remote-cutoff section, high-mu part of the two-triode card (work/tube-curves/6386: GE ET-T1113 1953, rms 0.54 mA over 65 points)

6386_B.note: 6386 low-mu part (same fit); its grid law is off (the high-mu part carries the section's grid current)

12BH7A.note: the LA-2A netlist's 12BH7A card (RCA 92CM-7742R1 fit, work/tube-curves/12BH7A)

6973.note: the Supro netlist's 6973 card (RCA 92CM-9380/9389 fit, work/tube-curves/6973)

6084.note: 6084 (= E80F) APPROXIMATE: Koren pentode fitted to Philips 6084 (8.8.1951, RTMA #1029, frank.pocnet.net sheets/201/6/6084.pdf) typical point 250 V / 100 V / -2 V -> 3 mA, gm 1.85 mA/V (card 2.92 mA, 1.85), Ig2 0.55 mA, and ten points read off the Va = 250 V transfer curves (Vg2 50-200 V) by eye; kvb assumed

1N538.note: 1N538 silicon rectifier (200 PIV, 750 mA): the 1N4001 card (same diffused-silicon class)

5651.note: 5651 glow-discharge reference as a breakdown law: 87 V burning voltage (RCA: 82-92 V), ~1.5 kohm incremental (3 V regulation over 1.5-3.5 mA); striking hysteresis not modelled

gr.note: Left channel's control voltage (T101 centre tap against the R142 ZERO reference, i.e. the rectifier's output across R137 / C109 / S102) mapped through the gain reduction measured on this circuit (1 kHz static sweeps at four AC / DC threshold settings fall on one curve within 0.3 dB). The panel meter reads 6386 plate current in its ZERO position; this is that reading expressed in dB. Re-measured 2026-11-12 against the current circuit (GZ34 output uncut, 6973 grid rail -12.9 V): 1 kHz static staircases at the factory condition and at AC THRESHOLD 0.35 / 0.5 / 0.65 with the attenuator at 0 dB put the gain reduction (against the small-signal gain) 0.28 dB (median; spread -0.07 to -0.69) above the earlier table between -54 and -7 V, so the table moved up by 0.28 dB there; points above 3 % THD (12-16 dB of limiting at 0 dB input attenuation) were left out.
